summary.text: Harold Dutton is a Democratic state representative and attorney who has represented Texas House District 142 since 1985 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Harold Dutton Jr. is an attorney who earned a BBA from Texas Southern University and a J.D. from the Thurgood Marshall School of Law.
Dutton took office in the Texas House in 1985.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the Juvenile Justice & Family Issues Committee and also served on the Public Education Committee.
Ballotpedia reports that in May 2011 he filed a federal lawsuit against the state of Texas arguing that prisoners should be counted in their home communities for redistricting purposes.
He advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Heidi Hall is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
